title: AI **in the process**
llm.n1: `connection` — a name; provider and key are **configuration**
llm.n2: `responseSchema` — the answer must be **valid JSON** for it
standin.model: model: local stand-in served by the workshop app (/fake/llm)
providers.sensitive: sensitive variables stay out of prompts · opt-in per step: `allowSensitiveVariables: true` (since 2.32)
agent.n2: `ref` checked against the **agent catalogue** at import
agent.n4: a JSON result → the next step branches on it
standin.agent: agent catalogue + runtime: demo stand-in (rules, not a model)
mcp.optin: MCP server: opt-in (spring-ai-starter-mcp-server-webmvc) · client: a script, no model
recap.head: AI in the process
recap.items: a judgement from a model — answer checked against `responseSchema`, usage recorded
a task for a published agent — result in a variable; needs the agent catalogue and runtime
the engine's operations as tools for an assistant — a dependency to switch on
recap.strip: the process decides what happens next — **every step is on record**
